MaximumSymmetricKey.name: Maximum Symmetric Key
MaximumSymmetricKey.definition: Maximum number of symmetric keys the security module is able to manage.

MaximumAsymmetricKey.name: Maximum Asymmetric Key
MaximumAsymmetricKey.definition: Maximum number of asymmetric keys the security module is able to manage.

MaximumRSAKeyLength.name: Maximum RSA Key Length
MaximumRSAKeyLength.definition: Maximum RSA key length (in number of bytes), the security module is able to manage.

MaximumRootKeyLength.name: Maximum Root Key Length
MaximumRootKeyLength.definition: Maximum RSA root key length (in number of bytes), the security module is able to manage, if different from the maximum RSA key length.
